content_prompt:
你是英语学习卡片的内容编辑。依据本卡目标词逐条制作内容，目标词集合必须原样保留；同一词允许复习，不新增主归属、不删除或替换目标词。不是要求所有英语句子严格仅用 Basic 850；允许必要的辅助词，但不计入850覆盖。
输出：1 场景与明确画面证据；2 每个目标词的本卡词义、词性、英美音标、自然搭配、短例句与中文、annotation_mode（object/action/relation/context）、evidence；3 图像生成提示词；4 主配文及中文，约8～18个英文词，优先自然、易懂，必要时用2～3句短对话；5 逐词覆盖检查与未完成项。
具体词标到物体，动作词标到动作，空间关系用真实对象关系或双幅对比；功能词与抽象词必须有包含该词或明确屈折形式的自然句子和语境，不给虚假的物体框。所有目标词都有独立可查的词条，即使主配文没有包含它。语法词在词句中高亮，不把冠词标成物体。
主配文草案均为原创，不冒充名著或名言。若要求文学配文，先找可核实的原文，提供作者、作品、原文位置、来源URL及使用依据。不得只根据作者去世就断言可商用；单独核查英文原文、所选版本和译文。改写必须标记 adaptation，原创译文标记 original_translation。查不到出处就使用原创句。无需每张都放名言，更不硬凑所有目标词到一条名言里。
音标和释义需按本卡词义重新核对，不能把源仓库的未经复核数据当成成品。坐标仅在最终图生成后设置；现在可给位置建议，不声称已有精确框选。输出status=content_draft，图片完成并逐词核对后才能改为approved。

image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: English scene-card base photograph, portrait 4:5. Refined Korean cool Instagram travel-fashion editorial with authentic environmental detail. Main subject is a stylish adult East Asian woman around 25, dark loose low bun, understated ivory/slate outfit, subtle magazine retouch while retaining pores, real hair and natural hands. Cool soft daylight, pearl white, fog grey, slate blue; true skin color. Clear teaching objects, coherent anatomy and perspective, deliberate breathing room near edges for later bubbles. No text, letters, digits, words, captions, brand, watermark, UI or learning labels. Photographic editorial triptych within one portrait frame, clean subtle divisions and no drawn schematic: upper two-thirds a natural side passenger view of the woman driver in a real parked compact car, seat belt correctly across chest, both hands naturally on steering wheel, eyes forward, cool daylight. Lower left inset is a realistic open engine bay showing engine cover and mechanical components, no text or labels. Lower right inset is a realistic driver footwell with one clearly visible rectangular brake pedal next to a narrow accelerator; flat shoe foot poised on brake, no extra limbs. Matching cool tones and documentary detail, steering wheel, engine and brake readable for vocabulary. The car is stationary during this posed lesson; speed and timing belong to later sentences. Simple blank interior upper corners for labels; no digital display, lettering, digits or logos.

image_review.summary: 主幅握方向盘教学姿势、左下发动机舱、右下宽刹车与窄油门真实可辨。脚在刹车上。静止教学图不证明行驶速度、停下结果或调整过程，slow/quick/stop/adjustment保持语境。图未明确显示完整安全带，不用于真实道路驾驶示范。
